test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 16 Oct, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 5.
solution:
The correct answer is '**dampen**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage is describing the feeling of joy among the friends over the political events that had taken place, and how that feeling was not lessened despite Indira Gandhi continuing as prime minister.
 
• The appropriate verb should indicate reducing or lessening the intensity of the joy.
 
• "**Dampen**" fits well as it means to lessen or reduce the intensity of a feeling or emotion, in this case, the joy the friends felt.
 
• Other options ("**adopted**", "**magnified**", "**diminished**") do not fit the context of modifying the intensity of the emotion described.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 1**'.

 

Complete Passage: *It was just before noon on June 26, 1975, and my friend and I were out exploring the bustling by-lanes of Delhi’s Karol Bagh, unaware that the Emergency had been declared, and that it would change our lives in ways we could have never * *imagined__* *. Though Indira Gandhi had herself announced the Emergency in a national broadcast at 8 am, IST, the news took its own time to reach the common people who went about their business as always. However, two hours into our outing, we * *__sensed__* * something was wrong. The pavement shops began to thin out as we watched and the bigger outlets too looked ready to * *__wrap up__* *; many of them worked behind half-downed shutters. We were young but fancied ourselves as political animals, which at the time was shorthand for being passionately anti-Congress and anti-Indira. There was no way we were going to head home without knowing what had happened. There was already considerable excitement in our small friends’ circle over two * *__landmark__* * developments: the June 12, 1975 Allahabad high court ruling unseating Indira for electoral malpractices and the Congress’s unexpected defeat in the State election in Gujarat. The Supreme Court had allowed Indira to continue as prime minister but that did not * *__dampen__* * our joy; it was a technical reprieve that did not lessen the political blow she had received.*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Adopted (अपनाया): "Adopted" means to take up or start to use, which does not fit the context of lessening the intensity of the joy.
 
• Magnified (बढ़ाया हुआ): "Magnified" means to increase or amplify, which is the opposite of lessening the intensity of the joy.
 
• Diminished (कम किया): "Diminished" means to reduce or lessen, which would technically be close in meaning but is not as contextually fitting as 'dampen' for describing the decrease in emotional intensity.
